description: This file contains a Zephyr RTOS application demonstrating SPI bit-banging with functions for writing and transferring 8-bit and 9-bit words, including loopback testing and main loop execution.

methods.name: test_basic_write_9bit_words
methods.description: Sends five 9-bit words over SPI, useful for logic analyzer verification.

methods.name: test_9bit_loopback_partial
methods.description: Performs a partial loopback transfer with 9-bit words, sending and receiving data.

methods.name: test_8bit_xfer
methods.description: Performs an 8-bit transfer at higher frequency, testing GPIO and SPI transfer.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing SPI device and running continuous demo loop.
